LPA (Lucht Probst Associates) :: product.text: Capmatix - RegTech platform for financial institutions Capmatix Capmatix – The All-in-One RegTech Solution for Structured Products & Beyond Capmatix by LPA is an advanced RegTech platform designed to help financial institutions navigate operational and regulatory challenges efficiently. With a strong focus on automation, compliance, and scalability , Capmatix streamlines workflows for structured products, OTC derivatives, and asset management. Why Choose Capmatix? Unlike conventional solutions, Capmatix integrates document creation, workflow automation, and financial engineering into a modular, scalable system. It ensures seamless data harmonization across departments and product models, optimizing compliance and efficiency. Key Use Cases: Structured Products (SP) – End-to-end automation for issuing, managing, and distributing structured financial products. Asset Management (AM) – Efficient regulatory document generation and distribution for investment products. Over-the-Counter (OTC) Products – Optimized workflows for corporate clients handling custom derivative transactions. By leveraging Capmatix, financial institutions enhance compliance, reduce operational complexity, and adapt quickly to evolving regulations — staying ahead in a competitive market. Challenges The financial industry is characterized by constantly growing regulatory requirements, complex processes and an increasingly dynamic market environment. Capmatix is the answer to these challenges – with software that has been specially developed to meet your requirements efficiently and future-proof. Flexibility & adaptability With its modular structure, Capmatix adapts perfectly to your specific requirements. Automation & efficiency Reduce manual effort, increase precision and save time with a solution that automates processes. Compliance without compromise Always stay up to date with regulatory requirements and react quickly to changes. Scalability for every company No matter how big your company gets, Capmatix grows with you and remains flexible. Turn Complexity into simplicity! Capmatix solves your challenges on front-to-back document creation and workflow management in Capital markets. Our Solution Capmatix – More than just a software Capmatix is the flexible, modular solution specifically designed to meet the complex requirements of the financial industry. With a powerful combination of automation, efficiency and scalability, Capmatix helps you optimize your processes and meet regulatory requirements with ease. Flexibility that simplifies your work processes and effortlessly provides your documentation in various formats. All languages Use Capmatix and create your documents in 25 languages at lightning speed – globally, efficiently and without limits! Compact & flexibility Choose the modules you need and adapt the solution exactly to your requirements. Automation & efficiency Reduce manual tasks, increase precision and save valuable time. Regulatory compliance Always stay up to date with the latest regulations and react flexibly to changes. Scalability From small businesses to global players – Capmatix grows with your needs. Truly Holistic Whether structured products , asset management or OTC . Capmatix has a solution for everything. WSD (Wall Street Docs) :: content.text: About Us Talk to us  About us We’re a global team of 250+ experienced professionals with a deep commitment to innovation and client service. An AI-enabled enterprise technology company built to transform complexity into clarity for the world’s leading financial institutions. Of the Top 10 Investment Banks in the world partner with us 100% Document Generation <2sec Faster onboarding of new trades >7 Million   1 / 4 We combine deep human expertise with engineered intelligence, delivering precision, reliability, and insight at scale. Our people and our platforms work together to empower ambition, simplify decision-making, and bring structure to the most demanding environments. Our Mission Through the strength of our people and technology, we empower ambition and transform complexity into clarity Our Values Collaboration We create impact together. Excellence We build with purpose and precision. Innovation We imagine the future, then build it. Our vision is to build a connected future where brilliant minds and advanced technologies converge to simplify the complex, exemplify trust and reduce friction to accelerate progress. WSD recognises that our social, economic and environmental responsibilities to all our stakeholders are integral to our business. We aim to demonstrate these responsibilities through our actions and within our corporate policies. We take all feedback that we receive from our stakeholders seriously and, where possible, maintain an open dialogue to ensure that we fulfil our own ESG requirements. We are committed to being open and honest in communicating our strategies, targets, performance and governance to our stakeholders in our continual commitment to sustainable development. Open and honest communication As is the case with all business, we believe that clear ESG communication with both internal and external stakeholders is fundamental to business sustainability and advancement. In addition to sharing ESG accomplishments to date, we know it’s important to share future goals to maintain accountability and success rate. We have recently completed an external ESG review, which has led to the development of bespoke recommendations and best practice guidance. This initiative helped us in creating a roadmap for improved ESG performance year-on-year, reflecting our commitment to sustainability and responsible business practices. For detailed insights into our recommendations, achievements from the past year, and future plans, please download our ESG report. The Team Our Executive Committee Mathias Strasser Founder  Mathias has practised law for more than 20 years, and has worked in the legal tech world for over ten years. He has broad legal experience and is a recognised expert in derivatives law and automation, having founded WallStreetDocs, RegXchange, PRIIP Cloud, and Scissero. Mathias holds an LL.M. from Harvard Law School, and a Mag.Jur and a Dr.Jur in law from the University of Vienna. Frances Weston Managing Director  Frances brings a wealth of experience to WSD, with a successful track record in the finance and technology sectors. Prior to joining WSD, she served as an independent M&A advisor in technology and Wealth Management, representing owners and investors. She also held the position of Managing Director Econocom North America, UK & IRL. She has led the EMEA Advisory Council to the Board of 100 Women in Finance and The French Chamber of Commerce, showcasing her commitment to driving positive change within the industry. Stephen Britton Chief Operating Officer  Stephen has 19 years of experience in the finance industry, with a track record of leading and executing complex projects. Prior to joining WSD, Stephen worked at Barclays Investment Bank, delivering a global electronic platform for cross-asset structured products. Stephen fosters financial literacy and career development through strategic partnerships with local charities. Stephen holds a BA in Economics and Philosophy from Nottingham University. Stephen Hender Chief Product and Technology Officer  Stephen leads the firm's technology and product strategy across its global business, overseeing architecture, engineering, product, QA, and controls functions to deliver scalable, modern platforms. A software developer and architect by background, he has deep expertise in designing large-scale, cloud-native systems. With over 20 years in Front Office, Risk, and Finance technology, Stephen has held senior leadership roles at S&P Global, Deutsche Bank, Barclays, and RBS, delivering major regulatory programmes and transformation initiatives. He combines technical depth with strong business acumen, enabling him to bridge strategy and execution while supporting clients with practical, technology-led solutions. ‍ Paige Orr Global Head of Sales  Paige joined WSD in 2024 after 5 years as Head of Sales at LMRKTS, a Capitolis company. Before LMRKTS, he helped build several top ranked institutional client businesses at Deutsche Bank, Barclays Capital and Standard Chartered Bank in the United States, Europe and Asia. Paige began his career in finance as a graduate at Bankers Trust Company in New York in 1995 and graduated magna cum laude from Connecticut College with a double BA in Economics (Honors) and International Relations (Honors and Distinction). Jan Valenthon HR Director  Jan is an experienced HR Director with over 20 years in medium-sized international organisations. His expertise spans compliance management, performance improvement, and process optimisation - driving operational excellence and sustainable people strategies across borders.   1 / 4 2025 Now Why Cegaware ? Risk manage a portfolio of derivatives and structured products is a very technical and heavy task that requires a robust and easily maintainable pricing engine to produce accurate and reliable analytics at a reasonable computational cost. ​ ​ Along the years, costly and complex solutions have been proposed to practitioners, hardly maintainable and costing too much for the users and the provider ​​s in terms of time and workforce. At Cegaware, we: ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​​​ Offer a unified framework to ease your derivatives management with full flexibility to integrate new payoffs and features Use optimized and modern infrastructure such as a smooth and friendly graphical user interface Maintain a comprehensive ecosystem of products at a very low cost and easily integrable within your workflows Provide a personnalized and reactive support , open to new ideas and projects to enhance your experience. About Cegaware FAQs What is Cegaware ? Cegaware is a modern fintech platform based in Dubai that provides pricing, risk analytics, and P&L tracking for derivatives and structured products. It combines flexibility, transparency, and cost-effectiveness compared to legacy solutions. Does Cegaware distribute market data ? No, Cegaware does not provide market data. You first need to subscribe to any external market data providers and then we will be able to help you to plug your providers to your own package of Cegaware for a complete experience. Upon subscrition to our service, we take in charge the developement of a specific API to execute market data requests to your providers. Does Cegaware trade for me ? No, Cegaware is not a trading platform but a software that produces advanced quantitative analytics to help you to understand your positions. At the end of the day, you are the one who make the trading decisions and are responsible for executing them. Can Cegaware handle my payoff ? Yes. Let us explain further: 1 - The software defines any financial contract by a simple, intuitive and generic language that aims to cover all kind of contracts. 2 - The user can use this language to design and book any contracts. 3 - The user can also use pre-defined contract template (autocall, vanilla, swap, ...). 4 - If you can't find a template that suits your needs, we can add it very quickly thanks to the generic contract description language. Our whole code base is built around this efficient technology. Does Cegaware store my market data or my external providers API keys ? No, we have not set any algorithms for this. This is not the aim of the service we provide. Your credentials will only be used to connect to your providers and request the data. The data that is pulled by our API at runtime will only be used to perform your request. At the end of every request, the connections to your providers are released. How is Cegaware different from traditional systems like Murex, Numerix, or Bloomberg? Unlike legacy systems, Cegaware is lightweight, highly customizable, and significantly more cost-effective. We focus on agility, faster time-to-market, and seamless integration into your existing infrastructure. How does Cegaware integrate with my existing systems? We provide multiple integration options: A public API for real-time interaction with your workflows. A Python package for scripting and automation. A DLL interface for integration with multiple programming languages. A modern web app with intuitive dashboards. Can I trust Cegaware’s pricing and risk analytics? Yes. Our pricing engine is independent, transparent, and based on the latest advances in quantitative finance. We ensure reproducibility and clarity in all calculations. What kind of risk analysis does Cegaware offer? Cegaware provides live Greeks, scenario shocks, ladder-based sensitivity tools, and P&L explanations, giving you a complete and intuitive view of your exposures. Who are Cegaware’s clients? Our platform is designed for investment banks, asset managers, brokers, family offices, and financial institutions seeking a modern alternative to expensive, rigid legacy systems. How long does it take to deploy Cegaware? Deployment is fast and flexible. Thanks to our modular architecture and open API, integration can be achieved within weeks rather than months or years. How can I see Cegaware in action? We offer 30-minute demos tailored to your needs. You can see how Cegaware fits into your workflow, test the platform, and explore potential synergies. How is market data handled? With Cegaware, we offer flexible market data integration options depending on the client’s preferences: • 𝐋𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐀𝐏𝐈 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐧𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 to your preferred data provider (e.g. curves, vol surfaces, FX spot, etc.). We develop the necessary connectors to fetch real-time data directly into the engine. • 𝐇𝐨𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐤𝐞𝐭 𝐝𝐚𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐚𝐬𝐞𝐬 on our/your side, allowing clients to contribute and retrieve their own quotes efficiently, reducing both latency and cost at pricing time. • 𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐮𝐚𝐥 𝐟𝐢𝐥𝐞 𝐮𝐩𝐥𝐨𝐚𝐝, where users can submit their own market data files. We adapt the platform to interpret the structure, as long as it follows a simple and documented format. This setup ensures clients can use the approach that best fits their infrastructure and operational needs. bottom of page
